summary_1line: Valmiki brings Sita before Rama at the sacrifice assembly so she may publicly prove her innocence before sages, kings, and the gathered world.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita walks behind the sage Valmiki with bowed head and folded palms as a vast silent crowd of sages, kings, monkeys, and warriors watches.
The immense assembly cries out in grief and reverence as Sita appears, some shouting 'Hail Rama' and others 'Hail Sita'.
Valmiki stands before Rama in the sacrificial arena presenting Sita and declaring that she will prove her innocence before all.
